source_reviews.src/bioetl/infrastructure/storage/target: Reviewed command and value boundaries for every maintained CLI writer. Valued options are normalized before recognizing help, dry-run and run-all listing; composite commands never inherit list-only semantics. The option terminator cannot turn workflow operands into flags. Actual Click parsers confirm flag-looking paths are consumed as values without invoking callbacks or runners. Six writer regressions failed before the correction; all 156 admission, dependency, binding and rehearsal tests pass afterward. Existing filesystem configuration reads retain their expressions, scopes, dispositions and resources; no new external resource site is introduced.
